title: Nutritious Middle Eastern Cannellini Beans Shakshuka
description: A light and nutritious one-pot Middle Eastern dish featuring cannellini beans, with a bitter flavor profile and high protein content, served in a shakshuka form. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomato, smoked paprika, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the cannellini beans and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Create 4 wells in the bean and tomato mixture, and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the crumbly feta cheese over the top.
Serve the shakshuka hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
